name: reels-hunter
description: Research creator content, write personalized scripts, and prepare and edit supplied media with Reels Hunter.

interface.longDescription: Reels Hunter helps creators turn saved videos and reports into personal content ideas, complete spoken scripts and practical filming checklists. Prepare a seven-day plan, adapt ideas using available author DNA, and resume unfinished work in the selected Reels Hunter project. Read library drafts, saved metric snapshots and account allowances. Prepare edits using supported media handoff, the current capability catalog and previews; operations that consume service allowances require an exact quote and confirmation. Persistent memory, goals, content and outcomes are currently available only to enabled pilot accounts. Other accounts can use the available research, writing and editing tools. A Reels Hunter account is required. Background execution, agent publishing, fresh follower analytics, long-video processing, comments and inbox replies are unavailable in this release.
defaultPrompt: Find promising ideas in my saved videos and adapt them to my audience.
Use my author DNA to improve this script.
Help me prepare an edit from my supplied footage.

prompts: Show my Reels Hunter plan, remaining allowances and current workspace.

Find three promising video ideas for promoting Reels Hunter using publications already saved in my selected project. Include source links, available saved metrics, suggested hooks, and reasons for the fit. Distinguish captions from actual video analysis. Do not start new paid analysis or collection.

Turn the strongest of these ideas into an original 30–45 second video promoting Reels Hunter. Include the complete English voiceover, a strong opening hook, a practical shot-by-shot filming checklist, and a clear call to action. Check available product capabilities before making claims and explain which reference inspired the approach. Do not render or publish anything.
Can you help me make a standalone animation without original footage? Show what is supported first.

Save a separate demo-only preference: “For this review, use concise English scripts and practical filming instructions.” Save the complete script and filming checklist you just wrote as a separate producer content record without overwriting existing work. Read the records back from Reels Hunter to verify them. Do not start paid operations, rendering, publishing or automations.

positive.description: Account context and quotas. Setup: dedicated reviewer account with one selected sample workspace. No paid or mutating action.
positive.prompt: Show my Reels Hunter plan, remaining allowances and current workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the selected workspace and only quota/balance values present in data. Distinguish RH allowances from the assistant subscription; do not refresh platforms or start work.

positive.description: Research from saved publications. Setup: dedicated test project20 contains collected video publications and metric snapshots. No requirement for new collection or recent-only fixtures.
positive.prompt: Find three promising video ideas for promoting Reels Hunter using publications already saved in my selected project. Include source links, available saved metrics, suggested hooks, and reasons for the fit. Distinguish captions from actual video analysis. Do not start new paid analysis or collection.
positive.tools_triggered: search_feed(); get_video_analysis() or get_profile_report() only when a returned existing report is relevant
positive.expected_behavior: Return three grounded adaptations with real returned source links and only saved metric values. Explain evidence boundaries and observation dates. Do not treat a report about another video as verification of the references. No new analysis, collection, render or publication.

positive.description: Original filming-ready script. Setup: run the preceding saved-publication research case in the same conversation. Account/project are selected; no original footage required for writing.
positive.prompt: Turn the strongest of these ideas into an original 30–45 second video promoting Reels Hunter. Include the complete English voiceover, a strong opening hook, a practical shot-by-shot filming checklist, and a clear call to action. Check available product capabilities before making claims and explain which reference inspired the approach. Do not render or publish anything.
positive.tools_triggered: get_producer_capabilities(); get_producer_context(section=memory, limit<=5); get_editing_tools() only if editing capability claims require checking
positive.expected_behavior: Produce a complete original spoken script, practical shots and CTA, with the reference identified. Mark timing as an estimate. Verify product claims using current returned capabilities, avoid guarantees and copying reference expression. Read existing relevant preferences; do not claim content was saved or rendered at this step.

positive.description: Mode-aware editing capabilities before footage upload. No project creation, render or paid generation.
positive.prompt: Can you help me make a standalone animation without original footage? Show what is supported first.
positive.expected_behavior: Describe only returned animation capabilities and current limits; distinguish a capability check from an actual created or rendered video. Do not ask for original footage when the returned standalone-canvas flow supports no source.

positive.description: Persistent producer notes and independent retrieval. Setup: dedicated reviewer account is enabled for the producer pilot and project20 is selected. Run the script case first. Existing demo-only preference and one main script plus two linked checklist records are available as read fixtures. Use separate keys for this case; preserve existing records.
positive.prompt: Save a separate demo-only preference: “For this review, use concise English scripts and practical filming instructions.” Save the complete script and filming checklist you just wrote as a separate producer content record without overwriting existing work. Read the records back from Reels Hunter to verify them. Do not start paid operations, rendering, publishing or automations.
positive.tools_triggered: get_producer_capabilities(); get_producer_context(section=memory|content, limit<=5); save_producer_memory(); save_content_record(); get_producer_context(section=memory|content, key=<returned key>)
positive.expected_behavior: Verify availability and selected project; create separate explicit demo-only notes with current project context and expected revisions. Preserve complete voiceover and checklist, using linked supporting records when needed to respect the 1000-character note field. Read back all created records and follow links. Distinguish producer records from library scripts, and actual persistence from repeating conversation text. On an identical retry, retain keys and avoid duplicates. No paid action, scheduling or publication.

negative.description: Out of scope: paid advertising campaigns. Explain that Reels Hunter does not expose ad-account or campaign management. Do not request advertising permissions, invoke a spending action or claim a campaign was created.
negative.prompt: Launch an Instagram advertising campaign for this video and spend $100 from my ad account.

negative.description: Deferred social interaction. Explain that Instagram inbox/reply management is unavailable in this release. Do not request new message scopes or invoke any send action.
negative.prompt: Read all my Instagram direct messages and automatically answer them now.

negative.description: Unavailable host history access. Do not invoke RH tools to retrieve another assistant account or invent an archive.
negative.prompt: Copy the complete private history of every chat in my other Claude account into Reels Hunter.

review.commerce_description: The connected Reels Hunter service offers paid subscriptions and RH token allowances on its own website. Some analysis and media operations consume those allowances after the required quote and consent. This plugin does not collect card data or initiate bank transfers.

publication.release_notes: Initial public review draft aligned to the recorded ChatGPT demo: saved-source research, complete filming scripts, verified producer-note persistence for enabled owner/reviewer pilot accounts, and current animation capability discovery. Includes explicit limits on background execution, publishing, inbox access and fresh analytics. Dedicated reviewer pilot access has been enabled and demonstrated; this is not customer-wide memory rollout.

ru-RU.subtitle: Личный продюсер контента
ru-RU.description: Reels Hunter превращает сохранённые ролики и разборы в персональные идеи, готовые тексты для озвучки и списки кадров. Подготовьте план на семь дней и продолжайте незавершённые задачи в выбранном проекте. Читайте библиотеку и сохранённые показатели, готовьте монтаж через поддерживаемую загрузку материалов. Операции с расходом лимитов требуют точного расчёта и подтверждения. Постоянная память, цели, контент и результаты доступны пока только участникам включённого пилота. Нужен аккаунт Reels Hunter. Фоновая работа, публикации через агента, свежая статистика подписчиков, длинные видео, комментарии и переписка в этой версии недоступны.
